## Localization Rules

Storefront is bilingual vi_VN (primary) + en_US. Storefront strings must be added to BOTH `vi_VN.csv` and `en_US.csv` translation dictionaries.

| ID | Description | Affected Areas | Test Approach | Confidence |
|----|-------------|----------------|---------------|------------|
| BR-001 | Storefront is bilingual vi_VN (primary) + en_US. vi_VN.csv + en_US.csv translation files present in Secomm modules. | all storefront templates, theme i18n | Switch store locale vi_VN/en_US; verify strings render in both | confirmed |

## Checkout Rules

Mageplaza One Step Checkout replaces the default Magento checkout. Address fields are converted to AJAX-driven hierarchical dropdowns for Vietnam. ExtraFee + DeliveryTime are installed.

| ID | Description | Affected Areas | Test Approach | Confidence |
|----|-------------|----------------|---------------|------------|
| BR-002 | Address fields are converted to AJAX-driven hierarchical dropdowns (country → state/province → city/district → sub-city/ward) via Secomm_AddressDropdown + Secomm_VietNamAddress data set (VN_Address.csv). | checkout, customer address, admin address CRUD + import/export | Walk full address cascade country→state→city→sub-city; verify admin CRUD + CSV import/export | confirmed |
| BR-004 | Mageplaza One Step Checkout (Osc + OscPro + OscUltimate) replaces the default Magento checkout. | checkout layout/flow, cart | End-to-end checkout QC + payment test | confirmed |
| BR-006 | Mageplaza ExtraFee (surcharge) + Mageplaza DeliveryTime (checkout delivery-time selection) are installed. | checkout totals, cart | Verify fee appears in totals; verify delivery-time selection persists | confirmed |
